author: zkyevolved
quote: This is my 4th play through of this game. 3DS, N64 and now on the Switch 2. I have to say, Nintendo has made an incredible remaster of this game. It's gorgeous, runs like a dream, and it's so faithful to the original yet adding a lot of quality of life enhancements. I have had very few games in my years in which I've screenshot so much! It is nostalgic, a breath of fresh air, and an absolute delight. But I must say that it does have a feel of the early years of gaming style, which is a pro and a con. But this to me is still a perfect game. I highly, highly recommend it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: zkyevolved
quote:
I feel like this game is nowhere near as fun as MK8D was. Firstly, the dynamic difficulty is absurd. Nintendo should have tied difficulty to the CC (50, 100, 150) rather than dynamically changing based on your skill. If you drive like a grandma, not flipping, not drifting, with terrible aim, you will end in 1st place. If you try your hardest with your skills that would always land you 1st place in 150 and 200 CC in MK8D, then you'll end in the top 3. After playing for a few weeks, it always felt off, then I searched why the AI is so brutal sometimes, and why boosting with a star is negligible, sometimes not even actually boosting, and then I found out why: Nintendo's Dynamic Difficulty. I'm sorry, but that's total bull. This game is not worth the money, not even at nearly half off with the bundle.

Graphics? 10/10
Animations? 10/10
Map design? 10/10
Total game? 6/10
